dashboard.label: Security Audit
dashboard.description: Audit weak ciphers, deprecated TLS protocols, self-signed certificates, and revocation anomalies.

table.title: Insecure Protocol & Weak Cipher Suite Audit

search.query: `ssl_cert_index` `ssl_cert_sourcetype` status!="CONNECTION_ERROR" | eval ssl_version = coalesce(ssl_version, negotiated_tls_version), ssl_cipher = coalesce(ssl_cipher, cipher) | stats latest(ssl_version) as ssl_version, latest(ssl_cipher) as ssl_cipher, latest(has_legacy_tls) as has_legacy_tls, latest(legacy_protocols_supported) as legacy_protocols_supported, latest(issuer_cn) as issuer_cn, latest(_time) as last_seen by dest, dest_port, sni | eval legacy_str = mvjoin(legacy_protocols_supported, ", ") | search ssl_version IN ("TLSv1", "TLSv1.0", "TLS 1.0", "TLSv1.1", "TLS 1.1", "SSLv2", "SSLv3") OR has_legacy_tls=true OR has_legacy_tls="true" OR ssl_cipher="*RC4*" OR ssl_cipher="*3DES*" OR ssl_cipher="*DES*" OR ssl_cipher="*NULL*" OR ssl_cipher="*MD5*" OR ssl_cipher="*EXP*" OR ssl_cipher="*anon*" | eval Target = dest . ":" . dest_port, Risk_Reason = case( has_legacy_tls=true OR has_legacy_tls="true", "Legacy Protocols Enabled (" . coalesce(legacy_str, "TLS 1.0/1.1") . ")", ssl_version IN ("TLSv1", "TLSv1.0", "TLS 1.0", "TLSv1.1", "TLS 1.1", "SSLv2", "SSLv3"), "Deprecated Negotiated Protocol (" . ssl_version . ")", true(), "Weak / Insecure Cipher Suite" ), last_seen = strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC") | table Target, sni, ssl_version, ssl_cipher, Risk_Reason, issuer_cn, last_seen | rename Target as "Endpoint", sni as "SNI", ssl_version as "Negotiated Protocol", ssl_cipher as "Negotiated Cipher", Risk_Reason as "Identified Vulnerability", issuer_cn as "CA Issuer", last_seen as "Audit Timestamp"

`ssl_cert_index` `ssl_cert_sourcetype` status!="CONNECTION_ERROR" | stats latest(is_self_signed) as is_self_signed, latest(subject_cn) as subject_cn, latest(issuer_cn) as issuer_cn, latest(signature_algorithm) as signature_algorithm, latest(days_remaining) as days_remaining, latest(valid_to) as valid_to, latest(_time) as last_seen by dest, dest_port, sni | where is_self_signed=true OR is_self_signed="true" OR is_self_signed=1 | eval Endpoint = dest . ":" . dest_port, Days_Left = if(isnotnull(days_remaining), round(days_remaining, 1), "N/A"), last_seen = strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z") | sort days_remaining asc | table Endpoint, sni, subject_cn, issuer_cn, signature_algorithm, Days_Left, valid_to, last_seen | rename sni as "SNI", subject_cn as "Common Name", issuer_cn as "Issuer", signature_algorithm as "Signature Algorithm", Days_Left as "Days Remaining", valid_to as "Valid Until", last_seen as "Last Detected"

`ssl_cert_index` `ssl_cert_sourcetype` | eval error_message = coalesce(error, error_message) | stats count, latest(status) as status, latest(revocation_status) as revocation_status, latest(revocation_reason) as revocation_reason, latest(error_message) as error_message, latest(_time) as last_seen by dest, dest_port, sni | where (NOT status IN ("VALID", "EXPIRING_WARNING", "EXPIRING_CRITICAL")) OR revocation_status="REVOKED" | eval Endpoint = dest . ":" . dest_port, Issue_Detail = case( revocation_status="REVOKED", "Certificate Revoked: " . coalesce(revocation_reason, "Reason Unspecified"), isnotnull(error_message) AND error_message!="" AND error_message!="null", error_message, status="CONNECTION_ERROR", "Endpoint Unreachable / Connection Timeout", status="EXPIRED", "Certificate Expired", true(), status ), last_seen = strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z") | sort - count | table Endpoint, sni, status, revocation_status, Issue_Detail, count, last_seen | rename sni as "SNI", status as "Status", revocation_status as "OCSP State", Issue_Detail as "Failure / Revocation Reason", count as "Total Probes Evaluated", last_seen as "Last Detected"
